selection.rule_text: Pick model from flap height (rows) vs flap weight incl. any handle (kg). Both fittings of a set are used (1 left + 1 right); table weights are per flap, for the 2-fitting set. Tables are 'sample measurements'; Haefele also gives an online weight calculator. With push-to-open catches the max weight is lower and depends on catch type (separate table).

selection.rule_text: KH = cabinet height (internal, between top and bottom panel as in drawing), front weight = whole 2-piece front. Choose the row where KH and weight range fit. notes: Haefele product family 'Free': Free flap 1.7, 3.15, H 1.5, Free space 1.11/1.8 push (stay flaps); Free fold (bi-fold); Free up (parallel lift); Free swing (swing-up). Electric 'E' versions via E-Drive (Free flap 372.91.099; fold/up/swing 372.37.099). Free flap, fold, up, swing are in the Haefele UK 2023 catalogue and Haefele Thailand brochure/2022 catalogue; Free space is in HTH 2022 and a 2019 Haefele manual.

Regional numbering differs: UK catalogue sells Free Fold as 372.38.5xx with weight ranges that differ from 372.37.5xx in the BRO/HTH22 list. Choose one set per target market; do not mix. UK also lists only some Free swing/up variants.

A1, A2 (front-edge offsets) and K/Y are variables used in formulas; their numeric definition is on the paper drilling template / hafele.com instruction PDF, which I could not retrieve. No number was guessed.
Drill depth for all side-panel holes in the Free family drawings is Ø5 x 12 mm; first hole position relative to top edge differs per fitting (flap 24.5 mm, space 102 mm from top as drawn).

Sources are official Haefele documents or distributor-hosted copies of them (Haefele UK files.hafele.co.uk; Haefele Thailand catalogue copies; Haefele mounting instruction copy). hafele.com / .it / .ro / .de product pages were not fetched in this session.
Several BRO vs UK vs HTH22 conflicts are flagged inline (fold pattern columns, up T/V1, swing overhang, fold depth 288 vs >270).
Numbers in drawings were read from rendered page images; letters shown as variables stay variables.
